name: Kleavor
description: A violent creature that fells towering trees with its crude axes and shields itself with hard stone. If one should chance upon this Pokémon in the wilds, one's only recourse is to flee.

moves.name: Quick Attack
moves.description: The user lunges at the target to deal damage, moving at a speed that makes it almost invisible. This also raises the user's action speed.

moves.name: Silver Wind
moves.description: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

moves.name: Aerial Ace
moves.description: The user confounds the target with speed, then slashes. This attack never misses.

moves.name: Stealth Rock
moves.description: The user launches countless stones at the target. Stone splinters left behind by this attack continue to damage the target for several turns.

moves.name: Double Hit
moves.description: The user adapts a hard-hitting stance to increase the damage dealt by its moves by 50 percent.

moves.name: Air Slash
moves.description: The user attacks with a blade of air that slices even the sky.

moves.name: Swords Dance
moves.description: A frenetic dance to uplift the fighting spirit. This raises the user’s offensive stats.

moves.name: Stone Axe
moves.description: The user swings its stone axes at the target, aiming to land a critical hit. Stone splinters left behind by this attack continue to damage the target for several turns.

moves.name: X-Scissor
moves.description: The user strikes at the target by crossing its scythes or claws as if they were a pair of scissors. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.

moves.name: Close Combat
moves.description: The user fights the target up close, inflicting damage without guarding itself. This also lowers the user's defensive stats.
